info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Streaming Subscriptions Plans-v2-spec
info.description: The Streaming Subscription Plans API provides a comprehensive overview of available streaming subscription plans for end-users. This endpoint allows developers to retrieve a curated list of subscription offerings, detailing features, pricing, and eligibility. Typical consumers include application developers and business analysts seeking to enhance user engagement through innovative subscription models. By integrating this API, businesses can ensure they stay updated on the latest subscription options to better serve their customers.

get.description: Fetch a list of available subscription plans for users. This endpoint provides detailed information about each plan, including features, pricing, and availability, allowing users to make informed decisions on their subscriptions.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve subscription plans available for users. It may include specific criteria for filtering or searching the subscription plans.
